title: Manual / backdated invoice entry
description: Let the warden manually add an invoice for a past period, needed to backfill dues history for a tenant onboarded mid-tenancy.
acceptanceCriteria: Invoice can be created for a period earlier than the current month
Manually added invoices behave identically to auto-generated ones for payment tracking

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Starting. Entry point: FAB on the Payments tab (InvoiceListScreen) -> a small active-tenant picker -> the manual invoice form, amount pre-filled from the tenant's agreedRent but editable. Reusing InvoiceRepository.existsForPeriod (built for LODGY-15's auto-generator) to block a duplicate for the same tenant+period here too, since AC2 asks manual invoices to behave identically to auto-generated ones.

Built ManualInvoiceTenantPickerScreen (active tenants only) and ManualInvoiceFormScreen (month/year as validated numeric fields like billingCycleDay elsewhere, amount pre-filled from the tenant's active agreement's agreedRent but editable, due date via DatePicker with no restriction - AC1's 'earlier than current month' works because nothing constrains the month/year fields to the present or future). Save calls the exact same InvoiceRepository.create() the LODGY-15 worker uses, so a manually-created invoice is byte-for-byte the same shape (UNPAID status, same columns) and shows up in the same InvoiceListScreen, can be paid via the same RecordPaymentScreen - satisfies AC2 by sharing the implementation rather than parallel code paths. Wired a FAB on InvoiceListScreen (Payments tab) as the entry point. `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

PASS - created a July 2026 invoice for Ravi Kumar (current month was September) - accepted with no error, appeared as "7/2026, UNPAID" in the invoice list (AC1). Tried creating a second invoice for the same tenant+period: form showed "An invoice already exists for this period" in red, Create Invoice disabled - confirms it shares InvoiceRepository.existsForPeriod with the auto-generation path rather than a separate check. Then recorded two partial payments and a final payment against this manually-created invoice via the normal RecordPaymentScreen (see LODGY-17) - status tracked PARTIAL then PAID exactly like an auto-generated invoice would, satisfying AC2.
